quotes.name: Alan Ljungström-Caunt
quotes.quote: I worked with Owoade at Eagle AI Labs and always found him easy to rely on. He takes real ownership of what he's working on. Once something was in his hands, it got done without needing to chase.

quotes.name: Taiwo Akinropo
quotes.quote: Working with Anu was bliss, he's a really good & solid engineer. I could hand off a feature, and he would figure everything out end-to-end, no hand-holding needed.

quotes.name: Seyi Osunade
quotes.quote: Anuoluwapo pays attention to details, keeps to timelines and was present at project meetings. He delivers on tasks assigned to him.

quotes.name: Israel Alagbe
quotes.quote: Anuoluwapo is a great person to work with. He is also very dedicated to his duties and you can always trust him to do the right thing even when no one is watching.
